g.title: Postpartum_Haemorrhage_QSP_Model
g.text: Primary Postpartum Haemorrhage — QSP Mechanistic Map
PPH is not a clotting disease. It is a
FLUX problem read against a store that pregnancy only made look large
Term uterine blood flow is ~750 mL/min. The whole blood-volume expansion of pregnancy (~2100 mL, 70 → 100 mL/kg) divided by that flow is
of unopposed flow; the model's totally atonic uterus reaches 516 mL/min, passes the class-III threshold (2100 mL) at

. Flow through a myometrium-compressed sinus goes as (1−tone)⁴, so the clinical band between "firm" and "boggy" is a few percent of contractile capacity: at ATN 0.60 the model loses 2218 mL and lives, at ATN 0.63 it dies at 70 min.
coagulation is locked out until the mechanics work

. Clot formation is shear-gated (fSH = 1/(1+(Q/80)²)): at 168 mL/min the gate is 0.19 and the placental-bed clot plateaus at 0.22, and a clot only becomes a DURABLE seal if it survives long enough at low shear to organise. Uterotonics and tamponade are therefore not alternatives to blood products — they are the precondition for them.
(OTR 1.00 → 0.09 by 120 min of infusion), so escalating the dose recovers 277 mL while crossing to an FP-receptor agonist recovers 925 mL. Fifth —
fibrinogen crosses its critical line first

(2.0/4.5 = 0.44 of baseline, vs 0.30 for factors and 0.20 for platelets), and the resuscitation that saves the circulation degrades the ligature: citrate-driven ionised hypocalcaemia and cold products cost tone directly.

g.title: cluster_third
g.text: 🩸 1. The third stage of labour — haemostasis at the placental bed is MECHANICAL. The spiral arteries are not ligated, sutured or clotted shut; they are squeezed shut by the myometrium contracting around them. Every drug in this map exists to make that squeeze happen

g.title: cluster_aeti
g.text: 🧬 2. Aetiology of atony — every risk factor in obstetrics enters this model through ONE number: ATN, the fractional loss of myometrial contractile capacity. ATN sets intrinsic drive (DRVI = 4.5·(1−ATN)) AND the ceiling drugs can push against (CAP = 1 − 0.45·ATN)

g.title: cluster_otr
g.text: 🔁 3. Oxytocin receptor dynamics — the pharmacological heart of PPH. OTR is a Gq-coupled GPCR that internalises on agonist exposure and recovers over hours. The SAME molecule used for induction, augmentation, prophylaxis and treatment is the one that removes the target

g.title: cluster_drug
g.text: 💉 4. Uterotonic PK/PD — four independent receptor systems converging on ONE contractile drive term. Because they are independent, they ADD; because the drive enters a saturating Hill, additions near the top are worth little and additions near the bottom are worth everything

g.title: cluster_4t
g.text: 🅃 5. The four Ts are not a differential-diagnosis list, they are four ALGEBRAICALLY INDEPENDENT terms. A drug that acts on one is invisible to the others — which is why failure to respond to uterotonics is diagnostic information, not a dosing problem

g.title: cluster_haemo
g.text: ❤️ 6. Haemodynamics — haemorrhage is partly SELF-LIMITING because the uterine circulation is pressure-passive (UBF ∝ MAP): falling pressure closes the tap. The same falling pressure also starves the myometrium of ATP, which opens it. Which term wins is the whole prognosis

g.title: cluster_clot
g.text: 🧫 7. Coagulation — the placental bed is the most hostile site in the body for a clot: 750 mL/min through 120 open stumps. Clot formation is SHEAR-GATED, and a clot only becomes durable if it survives long enough at low shear to organise. This is the lock that mechanics must open before biology can work

g.title: cluster_lysis
g.text: 🧪 8. Fibrinolysis — the placental bed and the shocked endothelium release tPA/uPA, so the clot is being destroyed while it forms. TXA does not make clot; it protects the clot that mechanics allowed to form. Its window is therefore not a fixed 3 hours — it is the duration of active bleeding

g.title: cluster_resus
g.text: 🧊 9. Resuscitation — every product carries a penalty that lands on the LIGATURE: citrate chelates the Ca²⁺ that myometrium needs to contract, cold products cool the enzymes AND the muscle, and saline dilutes the one factor with the smallest relative margin. The fluid that saves the circulation can open the tap

g.title: cluster_mech
g.text: 🔧 10. Mechanical and surgical control — these do not act on tone at all. They subtract flow directly, which is why they work when the whole pharmacological ladder has failed: they buy the low-shear window in which a thrombus can organise into a permanent seal

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 🎯 11. Clinical endpoints and organ consequences — what the model reports, and what the survivor is left with. Note that most of these are integrals of TIME SPENT below a perfusion threshold, not functions of the volume lost

g.title: cluster_arch
g.text: ⚙️ 12. Model architecture — 41 ODE compartments (10 drug PK · 31 disease/physiology), 12 scenario blocks, 70 kg term parturient, time in MINUTES

g.title: L_why
g.text: TXA can only protect a clot that still exists
and a bed that is still bleeding. This patient's
bleeding lasts ~40 min, so HER window is 40 min;
WOMAN's 3 h is the population's bleeding duration

g.title: R_ffparith
g.text: ★ DERIVED — FFP CANNOT RAISE A LOW FIBRINOGEN.
Raising 7 L by 1 g/L needs 7 g = 14 units = 3.5 L of FFP.
FFP's own concentration is 2 g/L, i.e. the
transfusion target itself ⇒ FFP drives fibrinogen
